title: 資料匯入匯出共用函式庫 — Raw CSV + Excel Table Parsing
content:
建立並維護所有資料匯入匯出功能共用的 CSV / Excel 工具庫。此次 AF-021 header mapping scope 更新後，AF-019 提供原始來源欄位 index、標題、資料列值與來源列號；跳過全空白列，只使用第一個非空白列作為來源標題候選，不要求符合特定 ExportColumn.header，也不得猜測後續標題。重複及空白標題依來源 index 保留。

CSV 匯出使用 UTF-8 BOM 與正確的引號跳脫；Excel 匯出/匯入使用 exceljs。既有 typed convenience importer 可保留給標題已知的呼叫方；AF-021 使用原始表格契約並在業務層套用管理員 mapping。此卡只維護格式工具，不處理業務欄位或 Prisma 存取。Raw-table parser implementation and focused verification are complete; awaiting human acceptance.

findings: 13 focused parser tests passed, covering raw CSV/XLSX source columns, duplicate/blank labels, row numbers, empty/unreadable files, and typed/export regressions
npm run lint exits successfully with 2 warnings in unrelated FAQ edit pages
npm run build passes; Next.js reports the existing middleware convention deprecation
evidence.residual: CSV multiline quoted-field parsing remains outside scope. The typed convenience importer still maps by declared labels; AF-021 must use the raw-table API for manual mapping. ExcelJS materializes workbooks in memory; the preview API limits files to 10 MB, but highly compressed XLSX expansion remains a resource-risk consideration.

acceptance: CSV export produces valid UTF-8 BOM CSV with correct escaping
CSV import exposes source column indices, raw labels/values, and original row numbers after skipping leading blank rows
Excel export produces valid .xlsx file that opens in Excel
Excel import exposes source column indices, raw labels/values, and original row numbers after skipping leading blank rows
Unreadable XLSX bytes return an explicit file-level ImportError instead of throwing
Arbitrary and duplicate source labels remain distinguishable by source index in both formats
A nonblank first row is never bypassed to guess a later header; all-blank/unreadable files return structural errors
Fully blank data rows are omitted while later source row numbers remain unchanged
ExportColumn[] → CSV string and Excel buffer both work
ImportResult returns correct counts and error details
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
Parser tests cover leading/data blanks, arbitrary/duplicate headers, source indices and row numbers, non-header first row, and empty files
